note: Anonymized aggregate record of the consolidated multi-corpus retrieval + mechanism + answer-sufficiency runs cited by docs/research/paper/rekal-paper.typ (arXiv:2607.14390). Values were transcribed from the operator-held consolidated run record; every cell must be proofread against that record (see paper/README.md). Corpora are identified by workload class only. No session content, corpus identity, or private path appears here.

A.profile: prose-heavy, diverse tooling (tool-path diversity 0.065; ~5,753 distinct paths); high commit-noise

B.workload: production software system (layered data/ML pipeline: ingest -> transform -> model build)
B.scale: ~50k lines of code; ~2,975-session repository scope; young recorded history

small_corpora.note: small n; tuning would overfit (OVFT-flagged); reported directionally only

retrieval_matrix_pooled_mrr_heldout.derived_note: best-config cells = tuned baseline + facet marginal; replace with exact cells from the operator record

mechanism_sweep_rho_disciplined.protocol: 10% dev / 90% held-out test; paired per-query bootstrap CI on the MRR difference excluding 0; candidate ships only if it beats the incumbent

rejected.rrf_fusion: no significant lift on any valid corpus
rejected.embedder_substitution: hosted general-purpose embedder moves neural-only, not the hybrid; n.s. on both valid corpora

kept.per_corpus_weight_tuning: B +0.032 [0.016,0.049] sig; small code corpus +0.134 [0.025,0.247] (small n); A within noise; hybrid>bm25 outright only on docs/architecture corpus +0.352 [0.158,0.549]

facet_term_spm_port.source: SPM (arXiv 2607.09493) facet idea ported to a retrieval term; retrieval MRR only, explicitly not a task-completion reproduction
facet_term_spm_port.implementation: deterministic per-session facet doc (distinct tool paths + command prefixes + steering text; no LLM; index-time); BM25 over facet_text as additive max-normalized 4th term; config-gated (facet_boost=0 default => byte-identical to baseline)
facet_term_spm_port.rule: marginal monotone in tool-path diversity (0.065 -> +0.110 vs 0.028 -> +0.053); shipped default is now facet_boost=0.3 (the tuned value, significant on both valid corpora); guarded facet index means corpora without facet material pay nothing; explicit 0 restores the byte-identical pre-facet engine

answer_sufficiency.protocol: n=15 real questions per corpus tagged broad/pointed/why; blind distinct judge; SUFFICIENT=1/PARTIAL=0.5/INSUFFICIENT=0; bootstrap 95% CI on overall; avg tokens per question
answer_sufficiency.transcription_note: per-kind cells transcribed from the draft's Table 1 photos; proofread required, especially routed-A per-kind and map-B why

episode_gating_isolated_n12.gate_effect: suppresses 11/12 bad injections; only 1/12 retrievals cleared the gate

ablations_corpus_B.gate_signal: top-1 score means 0.91 hit vs 0.87 miss; top1-top2 gap 0.046 vs 0.017

rationale_question.synthesis_adequate_gather_30_turns: yes (blind judge; ~2.1k tokens, one synthesis call)

not_run_specified: synthesis on mined T4 multi-hop gold (92-104 pairs in each of three high-co-occurrence corpora)
wild-question kind distribution (upgrades waterfall to one expected-cost figure)
gate recalibration after the facet term enters the score mix
frozen-snapshot re-run unifying all ratios in one matrix

single_corpus_rung1.headline: B5 hybrid default 0.187 pooled MRR vs B1 raw grep 0.005 (~37x; nDCG@10 57x), non-overlapping bootstrap CIs; drill ~1,500 tokens at 69% gold-term coverage
